scope: Joint-angle bounds only; no speed, torque, collision or dynamic certification.

mapping.confirmation_source: 2026-11-25 user clarified J3 hardware zero means a straight elbow, superseding the earlier all-joints CAD-zero assumption. Other joint zero positions and all positive directions remain as previously confirmed.

j3_zero_definition.hardware_zero: Upper-arm and forearm longitudinal axes aligned (straight elbow).
j3_zero_definition.method: Signed angle from J2 axis to J4 axis about J3 axis in the unrounded CAD model; this is a CAD kinematic calibration, not a measured encoder calibration.
j3_zero_definition.internal_coordinate_convention: Existing CAD q in radians is retained; do not shift old pose arrays or apply the offset twice.
